Coram : INDIRA BANERJEE, J.K. MAHESHWARI
Major Port Trusts Act, 1963 – ss.48-50 – Notification – Anchorage fees – Calculation of – Appellant purchased a Vessel in an auction conducted in a Commercial Admiralty Suit – Bill of Sale stated that the Vessel was sold free from the successful bidder would be liable to pay the costs, charges, fees and expenses involved in removing the Vessel – When the appellant was going to remove the Vessel, disputes arose inter alia w.r.t anchorage charges claimed by respondent no.1 – Application filed by appellant
Decision Date : 22-09-2022 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6858/2022 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
